purpose: Review eight official Tesla management capabilities, keeping account metadata, paid specifications, partner pricing and enterprise billing separate from physical vehicle commands.
primaryGoal: Inspect available cached account data for the workspace vehicle and explicitly request permitted refreshes or confirmed operations without implying account access or undocumented payload semantics.

dataSources.behavior: vehicleKeys.all, abort signal, FAST stale time and safeArray normalization. useSelectedVehicle also subscribes to the same query, rather than establishing an independent fetch/cache. URL/store/first-known-vehicle precedence is owned by web\src\hooks\useSelectedVehicle.ts:50-79. Page passes the resolved vehicle ID and keys the workspace by it.

Vehicle-scoped reads are enabled only with an ID and forward cancellation signals. Refresh POSTs invalidate their own query and use mutation toasts. Specs refresh sends confirmed:true. STATIC/RARE/DAILY policies remain as authored. Envelope data and fetched_at are passed through; cards display upstream Tesla endpoint descriptions, not the internal URLs. UI claims paid cost and a 24-hour guard; backend enforcement was not inspected.

Roles use the vehicle-enterprise-roles key, RARE stale time, enablement and cancellation. Pricing sends {payload}; payer sends {payload,confirmed}, requiresLiveMode:true and invalidates roles. Pricing and payer results are mutation/session state, not persisted queries. Payload meaning and upstream authorization are explicitly unknown to the UI.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Four metadata cards intentionally reuse one ManagementEndpointCard, also used by specs, roles, pricing and payer. Five specialist views reuse ManagementRawDetails/StructuredDataView. These are already consolidated owners, not eight new shared-component requests.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep these domain owners and prop contracts; do not extract another generic endpoint framework.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: formatReportedPrice and formatReportedTotal repeat the same currency/locale/precision pipeline with different nullable values.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one small domain-local formatter accepting reported amount and currency; retain zero, unknown currency, locale and precision behavior.

sourceBehavior: VehicleManagementWorkspace.tsx:71-79 uses one column below xl and two above xl, preserving all eight cards.
ManagementEndpointCard.tsx:94-105,134-151 uses min-w-0, wrapping footer controls, break-all endpoint code and wrapLabel.
StructuredDataView.tsx:89-106 reflows key/value records at sm and technical details are bounded to max-h-80 in ManagementRawDetails.tsx:19.
OpaqueJsonDialog.tsx:68-109 uses lg Modal and stacked/reversed mobile form actions; Modal.tsx:133-137 provides small-screen full-width viewport bounds.
VehicleSpecsDataView.tsx:46-74 uses semantic Table with local overflow-x-auto supplied by Table.tsx:20-23.
Options, subscriptions and warranty internals reflow at sm without hiding fields.

issues.detail: Columns depend on viewport xl, not allocated workspace width. CSS column-major order and tall independently loading cards may change perceived reading/navigation order. No actual overflow or ordering failure was exercised.
issues.fix: Validate ten prescribed widths and allocated-container constraints with all cards/long data; retain source ordering and all actions when selecting existing container-aware layout options.

responsive.status: Source only; 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, text zoom, RTL and long open-dialog behavior unverified.

sourceBehavior: Workspace section is named by vehicle-management-title; endpoint LayoutCard creates unique title IDs.
Actions use named shared Button controls; JSON Textarea has explicit id, label, required and error feedback.
Modal uses shared useDialogFocus and closed dialogs return null, so two closed JSON dialogs do not alone prove duplicate live IDs.
Payer requires PAYER typed confirmation; paid specifications require a separate warning confirmation.
Specification rows have scope=row and the Table is named; structured technical records use dl/dt/dd.
FadeIn uses useMotionPreference and initial=false under reduced motion; no ambient feature animation appears.

issues.detail: Endpoint actions use size=sm; Button.tsx:38,47 defines 36px minimum height. The page retry at VehicleManagementPage.tsx:75 also uses sm. This is below the 44px stronger mobile default; spacing exception and actual composed target size are unverified.
issues.fix: Apply existing Button sizing/class options for mobile min-height 44px without globally changing density or deleting wrapping labels.

issues.detail: Specialist views use h4 under LayoutCard's panel Heading; verify the actual h1/h2/h3 outline rather than assuming it from level names.
issues.fix: Retain descriptive headings and use existing typography as overrides if the mounted heading outline skips levels.

accessibility.status: Keyboard, focus containment/restoration, assistive technology, target reachability, actual contrast, forced colors and motion acceptance unverified.

states.loading: Roster AlertBanner remains separate from permanently mounted workspace. Each metadata source owns loading ListSkeleton; action loading is independent.
states.empty: Empty roster notice and no-vehicle notice retain all cards. Successful empty results differ from never-cached/session results. Specialist parse-empty views retain technical details.
states.error: Roster fatal error has explicit retry. Endpoint errors use ErrorDisplay or prerequisite unsupported notice for API statuses 402/412; refresh actions remain available subject to vehicle prerequisites.
states.stale: Roster uses complete query-derived useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning. Endpoint retained renderable data survives refresh failure with DataStateNotice.
states.offline: Roster forwards query fetchStatus through useDataState. Endpoint cards do not forward paused/offline metadata.
states.success: operationSucceeded renders request-completed notice; fetchedAt or operation success distinguishes a completed empty response.
states.disabled: Vehicle-scoped actions are disabled without ID. Mutation pending disables action via Button loading; JSON input/cancel are disabled for pending pricing submission.

issues.detail: deriveDataState receives only inner payload, error and loading. Query fetchStatus/isFetching/dataUpdatedAt/refetch and envelope freshness are not propagated. Paused endpoint reads cannot show offline/blocked-refresh trust, and initial loading has no dedicated paused distinction.
issues.fix: Pass the existing source DataState from each read query through the domain card/body, preserving envelope payload and mutation feedback independently. Reuse DataStateNotice rather than another state framework.

issues.detail: A null inner payload counts as retained data because deriveDataState tests only undefined (dataState.ts:191); a later error plus fetchedAt may render a stale notice and 'Tesla completed the request' empty wording. Empty prior success and failed current refresh need distinct explanation.
issues.fix: Preserve the cached empty result and refresh failure, but distinguish last completed result from latest failed operation using the full envelope query state.

visualIssues.detail: All endpoint icons use fixed cyan decoration despite different meanings; workspace/warranty use violet and subscription uses blue. These fixed hue accents add nonsemantic multicolor noise and bypass neutral theme tokens. Saturation/contrast has not been visually measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/text tokens for decorative icons. Keep semantically meaningful warning/danger/success badges and the options active-state emerald cue.

visualIssues.detail: Every nested field is framed with border/surface/padding; this stacks with technical accordion, endpoint card and specialty subcards. Dense payloads may become box-heavy; no visual defect is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing embedded/flat surface composition for technical nesting while keeping every key/value, redaction and expandability. VehicleSpecsDataView may use Table variant=embedded at line 46.

architectureIssues.detail: Shared LayoutCard imports Button/Card/Heading/Text/Tooltip through the UI category barrel, contrary to the shared-implementation concrete-import convention. No cycle or runtime failure is proved by this source observation.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the exclusive shared owner switch internal dependencies to their concrete existing modules without altering LayoutCard props or feature imports.

architectureIssues.detail: MAX_RENDER_DEPTH=8 replaces deeper source data with 'Additional nested data'; no expand/download action exists in this renderer. Technical payload accessibility is bounded rather than complete. This is an existing preservation limitation, not authorization to drop more fields.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the safe initial depth but add domain-local progressive expansion through existing Accordion/Button, preserving redaction and every deeper non-sensitive value. Do not invent backend fields or raw secret export.

architectureIssues.detail: A flat named warranty record with no grouped status is assigned state='active' by fallback, potentially presenting unknown coverage as active. Actual upstream payload semantics were not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm the source contract; represent unclassified coverage separately if status is not authoritative, retaining all fields and avoiding guessed current coverage.

priority.reason: Preserve financially consequential confirmation/session boundaries first; repair endpoint trust metadata and bounded technical-data reachability, then neutralize decorative hues and validate mobile controls. Page itself is already a thin shared-layout orchestrator.

requiredSharedChanges.fix: Replace internal UI barrel imports with concrete modules under exclusive shared ownership.

competingImplementations.detail: Page recomputes selected-record/ID/first-fleet fallback after useSelectedVehicle already resolves the workspace. It uses the same roster cache and adds no picker; this is a small redundant derivation, not a proven conflicting selector.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep existing selection precedence and keyed reset; simplify only with confirmed equivalence to the shared selector, never introduce a local vehicle/date control.

competingImplementations.detail: No competing overlay, fetch engine, stat engine, table pipeline or management framework found in inspected production dependencies. Table is legitimately a read-only semantic matrix, not an attempted DataTable replacement.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse current domain/shared owners; no speculative shared components.

preservation.lineCountScope: Exact page plus 20 non-test files in components\vehicle-management, including index and two domain utility files; not a page-only reduction target.

sections.name: Workspace introduction, eight-endpoint badge and no-vehicle notice

actions: Retry roster GET without replacing usable retained data.
Refresh options, warranty, subscriptions, upgrades and enterprise roles independently.
Request paid specifications only after the $0.10 confirmation; retain displayed 24-hour guard information and confirmed:true request.
Open pricing JSON form, validate non-empty JSON object, cancel or submit; preserve session-only response and unknown Tesla schema warning.
Open payer JSON form, validate and stage payload, continue to typed PAYER confirmation, cancel/clear or send confirmed:true live-only operation; retain billing risk warning.
Expand technical details for options/specs/warranty/subscriptions/roles; retain generic structured upgrades/pricing/payer results.
Workspace vehicle changes remount the domain workspace and reset local mutation/dialog/staged-result state.
dataBehavior: All eight cards remain mounted when vehicle context is unavailable; only vehicle-scoped reads/actions disable, while partner pricing stays independent.
Retain shared workspace selection, URL/store fallback, query keys, enablement, cancellation, policies, source envelopes, fetched_at, mutation errors/toasts and targeted invalidation.
Do not reinterpret displayed upstream /api/1 descriptions as internal request URLs; every inspected internal hook path matches router declarations.
Retain prerequisite labels and 402/412 unsupported state without claiming actual user/partner/enterprise access.

Preserve options code/name/active-unknown distinction/paint, scalar specs, warranty active/upcoming/expired counts and terms/dates/reported odometer, subscription market/offers/currency/period/price/total, roles and generic payload keys.
Warranty odometer has explicitly unknown units; preserve as reported with its explanatory note, do not invent SI conversion.
Currency rendering retains reported currency and locale, missing remains missing and zero remains zero. No SI wire/cache transformation was introduced.
Sensitive technical keys remain redacted; original payloads and unknown field semantics must not be removed or recased during modernization.

sourceScan.scope: Page and non-test vehicle-management dependencies only
sourceScan.notes: PowerShell Select-String case-insensitive initial raw-control scan returned 6 shared-component false positives; corrected -CaseSensitive scan returned 0. No absence claim for shared CSS/theme implementation.

evidenceLimits: Phase0 source inspection only. Assigned route is recorded verbatim; route mounting/reachability was not browser exercised.
No source edits, Git operations, repository lint/build, TypeScript, tests, browser, runtime mutations or visual captures performed.

The loaded audit skill script was inspected but not executed: it unconditionally invokes full frontend TypeScript, outside this assignment. Equivalent bounded source pattern checks were executed instead.

Runtime, API payload correctness, server cache/24-hour billing guard/authorization, cancellation execution, offline recovery, complete-data equivalence, visual saturation, contrast, keyboard, viewport and reduced-motion behavior are unverified.
One bounded scan command failed with PowerShell quoting ParserError (exit 1); corrected scoped scan completed (exit 0). Hash/line counts and route declarations were read directly.
No global theme/catalog/router/query graph audit or second-page consumer search. Shared requirements name only this inspected consumer and do not invent multi-page demand.
Primitive internals not listed in filesRead were not read; source imports are ownership evidence, not implementation acceptance.
Design contract/conventions read fully; mission sections 0,1,15,33,43,44 read with adjacent text. Audit output schema is the complete top-level convention list.
